text: Switzerland ranks only fourth in the number of ICOs launched yet first in total funds raised, so the average Swiss ICO project raises a greater than average amount of funds.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses

abstract: Switzerland is the country with the 4th most ICO's launched but the greatest amount of funds raised in total. Accordingly, the average project in Switzerland is raising a greater than average amount of funds.
